tasks.title: Family tasks
tasks.emptyHint: Tasks are created by an Agent with the miloco plugin (e.g. OpenClaw); they'll show up here once created
tasks.confirmDeleteMessage: Delete "{{desc}}"? The task and its rules and records will be removed and cannot be recovered.
tasks.noRules: No linked rules yet (may still be waiting for the Agent to wire it up)
tasks.rulesManagedHint: Rule name, trigger condition and the intent on match are all editable and take effect right after saving. Direct device actions and push notifications are wired by the Agent; chat with it to adjust.
tasks.triggerPlaceholder: Describe what counts as a match, e.g. the kid is studying at the desk
tasks.triggerPhrasingHint: Describe an ongoing state or an observable action. Don't start with an assertion like "detected that…", or it will be read as an already-established fact.
tasks.ruleNameHint: The rule name goes into the perception model together with the trigger condition, so editing it affects matching. The task-id prefix is fixed.
tasks.ruleNamePlaceholder: Scene description, e.g. someone moving in the living room
tasks.ruleIntentHint: This is the "what to do" text the Agent reads when the rule fires. Changes take effect immediately.
tasks.intentPlaceholder: Describe what the Agent should do, e.g. remind the resident to stand up
tasks.ruleIntentLocked: This action is wired to direct device control; chat with the Agent to adjust it.
tasks.howToTitle: Want to add a task? Just tell the Agent
tasks.howToBody: Tasks are created — and their perception rules wired up — by an Agent with the miloco plugin (e.g. OpenClaw), not by the web app. Just chat with that Agent and describe what you want in one sentence, for example:
tasks.example1: Help me watch that my kid practices piano 30 minutes a day and remind me when done
tasks.example2: Remind the elder at home to measure blood pressure once a day
tasks.example3: Let me know if a window is left open when nobody's home
